text: Refunds are handled by our support team. You can request a refund up to 30 days after delivery.
We deliver island-wide. Orders within Colombo arrive in 2 working days, and other districts take 4 to 5.
All kettles come with a one year warranty. Keep your receipt to make a claim.
We accept Visa, Mastercard and PayHere. Cash on delivery is available for orders under Rs. 15,000.
You can close your account at any time. Go to Settings, then Privacy, then Delete account.
